description: The user pasted, commented, removed a comment or cleared: the whole redline. An empty text with no comments means there is no text under review.

text.description: The pasted markdown, line breaks as \n.

items.description: One comment: an instruction about the fragment of the text from start to end.

start.description: Character offset in text where the fragment starts.

end.description: Character offset in text just after the fragment.

quote.description: The fragment itself: text from start to end.

text.description: The comment the user wrote on it.

comments.description: The comments, in reading order; fragments never overlap.
